item: Phase C blob store: design note + benchmark (R700, Q1009 rows 3-6)
status: design + benchmark only; no store change; design choices provisional (R707)
summary: Benchmark of the current SQLCipher store vs a Phase-C prototype (HMAC-addressed, deduplicated, fixed-size padded OOPACK1 packs with OOENC2 STREAM framing and per-pack subkeys, crash-ordered writes): a single-article read costs ~1.7 ms with 4 MiB frames and ~65 us with 64 KiB frames (today 37 us); disk -20% at 20% duplicates, -43% with zlib; ingest within ~15%. sqlite3mc not measured (wheel download refused by the sandbox safety check). Design note: keys (stored master key with epochs), envelope, dedup leak, crash table, GC and deletion retention, backup/restore and panic wipe (pack tree must be unlink-only), R707 rulings and open questions Q-W9..Q-W13.
